page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is a general-purpose instance type powered by the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores and 128 vCPUs, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It also lacks integrated GPU accelerators. However, it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers and efficient communication with external storage volumes and network resources.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7.32xlarge offers a high-density allocation of dedicated compute resources and memory within a single virtual machine, reducing the overhead of managing multiple smaller instances. The balanced resource profile makes it suitable for enterprise applications, large-scale web serving, containerized microservices, and general-purpose workloads that require substantial compute capacity and high network throughput without specialized GPU or local storage requirements.
